items.title: Where people look for homes
items.body: Residents often compare listings on property apps and classifieds, and visit areas in person before deciding. Listings can be out of date, so confirm with the agent.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Read the tenancy contract carefully
items.body: Check the rent, the number of payments, the deposit, who pays maintenance, and the notice period. Ask how the contract is registered in your emirate.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Check the agent and the property
items.body: Ask to see the agent's licence and the owner's documents. Never pay before seeing the property and signing a contract.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Visit before you pay
items.body: Check water pressure, air conditioning, parking, noise and the walk to transport or school at the time of day you will use them.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Questions to ask about costs
items.body: What is included in the rent? Who pays utility deposits, maintenance and agency fees? Can the rent be paid in more instalments?
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Questions to ask before moving in
items.body: When will the property be ready? What condition must it be returned in? Is a move-in inspection report provided?
